title: Sorceress with Hellhounds
description: A woman in a futuristic black and blue bodysuit stands with arms outstretched on a circular reflective platform featuring three stacks of glowing blue stones. She is surrounded by five floating demonic wolf-like creatures with glowing red eyes and large black horns. In the background is a dark fantasy city with gothic spires, cherry blossom trees, and a massive glowing blue circular portal in the starry sky.
